messages:
lee: publish-bot blocked py SDK release, regendiff flagged a change in retry middleware types. can someone triage?
publish-bot: publish blocked for @redwood/sdk-py. Regendiff: signature change detected in AuthRetryOptions (semver-major risk). See pipeline log: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9999
tanya: got the regendiff output — looks like the retry config went from optional in the client to required in the generated code.
ben: that's odd. which generator produced the types? I thought we pinned openapi-python-gen to 2.3.
lee: CI used openapi-python-gen 3.0.0 (auto-upgraded via yarn.lock bump in infra repo). diff snippet:
```diff
-    def create_user(self, body: CreateUserRequest, retry: Optional[RetryConfig] = None) -> User:
+    def create_user(self, body: CreateUserRequest, retry: RetryConfig) -> User:
```
ben: yup that's a breaking change — suddenly non-None assumption. sample-app CI fails with: `TypeError: missing positional argument 'retry'`
tanya: quick unblock options: 1) pin generator back to 2.x in CI, 2) add a compatibility wrapper in SDK runtime that provides a default RetryConfig when missing, 3) update sample-apps to always pass retry (but that's a lot of churn).
lee: prefer 2) wrapper in SDK runtime so published package remains semver-patch. we should not force all customers to change immediately.
ben: agree. I can add a small runtime shim where generated client methods are wrapped to normalize signature: if retry is omitted, pass RetryConfig.default(). That avoids touching generator templates and is faster.
tanya: add a test that runs regen and verifies regendiff sees no signature removal. Also add a changelog entry explaining the compatibility shim, and a TODO to remove after 2 releases.
lee: good. infra note: we also need to prevent future accidental generator upgrades — @infra-bot, can we lock openapi-python-gen to 2.x in the release pipeline?
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-3176 to pin generator in release pipelines and added auto-approve rule to notify owners on any generator.version change.
ben: opening PR with shim + tests: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/4987 (WIP). will include unit tests and a regen run artifact.
lee: once merged, rerun `./scripts/regendiff --ci` in release pipeline and trigger publish-bot retry.
tanya: also ping the spec owners — I found a spec change that removed optional marker on retry in commit a1b2c3. if that was intentional we should coordinate an official deprecation path. I can draft an email and a spec PR to add `deprecated: true` or a migration note.
ben: PR opened, CI kicked: build 8011.
devex-bot: reminder: label PR with release-blocker to force full integration tests after merge.
lee: nice. after CI green, we will backfill changelog and unblock the publish. who will do changelog?
tanya: I will. adding entry: "compat(sdk-py): runtime shim for RetryConfig to avoid semver-major due to generator upgrade — revert in two releases."
ben: CI passed on branch (build 8011). merging once we have approval.
lee: merging now. post-merge steps: run regen diff in release job and ask publish-bot to re-evaluate.
publish-bot: re-evaluation queued after merge.
lee: followup: schedule a short retro to decide generator upgrade policy and add a checklist item to run sample-apps locally after any generator bump.
tanya: noted and will add to eng-oncall checklist. :white_check_mark:
lee: thanks all for the quick turnaround.
